title: Chapter One: Make Your Mark
search_title_used: barry chapter one make your mark
premise_summary: "Chapter One: Make Your Mark" is the pilot episode of the American tragicomedy crime drama television series Barry. It was directed by Bill Hader, who stars in the title role, and co-written with Alec Berg. The episode establishes the plot of the series, about an American Marine Corps veteran turned hitman who decides to pursue an acting career after following a mark to acting class. It aired on March 25, 2018, on HBO.
